events.label: Button click
events.trigger: PLAY, GO, CASH OUT and stake controls are pressed.
events.prompt: A single soft tactile interface button click, warm muted pop with a tiny crisp tick, very short and dry, no music or voices.

events.label: Cash out ready
events.trigger: CASH OUT becomes available for the first time in a round.
events.prompt: A brief soft two-note interface confirmation chime, warm rounded plucked tones rising gently, dry, no voices or background music.

events.label: Win popup
events.prompt: A small handful of coins dropping into a metal cash tray, bright satisfying brief jingling clinks settling, close mic, under one second, no voices or music.

events.label: Win transfer
events.trigger: Coins fly into the balance (same file, played 12% faster).
events.prompt: A small handful of coins dropping into a metal cash tray, bright satisfying brief jingling clinks settling, close mic, under one second, no voices or music.
